```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ISLR)
library(leaps)
library(glmnet)

# Load Hitters data
data(Hitters)

# Remove rows with missing values
Hitters_clean <- na.omit(Hitters)
dim(Hitters_clean)
```

2. Split Data into Train and Test Sets


```{r}
set.seed(123) 
n <- nrow(Hitters_clean)
train_indices <- sample(1:n, size = 0.8 * n)
train <- Hitters_clean[train_indices, ]
test <- Hitters_clean[-train_indices, ]

cat("Training set size:", nrow(train), "\n")
cat("Test set size:", nrow(test), "\n")
```

3. Best Subset Selection
```{r}
# Perform best subset selection
best_subset <- regsubsets(Salary ~ ., data = train, nvmax = 19)
best_summary <- summary(best_subset)

# Create results dataframe
best_results <- data.frame(
  nvars = 1:19,
  adjr2 = best_summary$adjr2,
  bic = best_summary$bic,
  cp = best_summary$cp
)

# Find best models according to different criteria
best_adjr2 <- which.max(best_summary$adjr2)
best_bic <- which.min(best_summary$bic)
best_cp <- which.min(best_summary$cp)

cat("Best model by Adjusted R²:", best_adjr2, "variables\n")
cat("Best model by BIC:", best_bic, "variables\n")
cat("Best model by Cp:", best_cp, "variables\n")

# Get coefficients for each best model
coef_adjr2 <- coef(best_subset, best_adjr2)
coef_bic <- coef(best_subset, best_bic)
coef_cp <- coef(best_subset, best_cp)

cat("\nCoefficients for best model by Adjusted R²:\n")
print(coef_adjr2)
cat("\nCoefficients for best model by BIC:\n")
print(coef_bic)
cat("\nCoefficients for best model by Cp:\n")
print(coef_cp)
```
4. Training and Test MSE for Best Subset Models
```{r}
# Function to get predictions from regsubsets object
predict_regsubsets <- function(object, newdata, id) {
  form <- as.formula(object$call[[2]])
  mat <- model.matrix(form, newdata)
  coefs <- coef(object, id = id)
  xvars <- names(coefs)
  mat[, xvars] %*% coefs
}

# Calculate MSE for each best model
criteria <- c("AdjR2", "BIC", "Cp")
best_sizes <- c(best_adjr2, best_bic, best_cp)
train_mse_best <- numeric(3)
test_mse_best <- numeric(3)

for(i in 1:3) {
  # Training MSE
  train_pred <- predict_regsubsets(best_subset, train, best_sizes[i])
  train_mse_best[i] <- mean((train$Salary - train_pred)^2)
  
  # Test MSE
  test_pred <- predict_regsubsets(best_subset, test, best_sizes[i])
  test_mse_best[i] <- mean((test$Salary - test_pred)^2)
}

best_subset_results <- data.frame(
  Criterion = criteria,
  nVars = best_sizes,
  Train_MSE = train_mse_best,
  Test_MSE = test_mse_best
)

print(best_subset_results)
```

5. Forward Stepwise Selection
```{r}
# Forward stepwise selection
forward_select <- regsubsets(Salary ~ ., data = train, nvmax = 19, 
                             method = "forward")
forward_summary <- summary(forward_select)

# Find best models
forward_adjr2 <- which.max(forward_summary$adjr2)
forward_bic <- which.min(forward_summary$bic)
forward_cp <- which.min(forward_summary$cp)

# Calculate MSE for forward stepwise
train_mse_forward <- numeric(3)
test_mse_forward <- numeric(3)
forward_sizes <- c(forward_adjr2, forward_bic, forward_cp)

for(i in 1:3) {
  train_pred <- predict_regsubsets(forward_select, train, forward_sizes[i])
  train_mse_forward[i] <- mean((train$Salary - train_pred)^2)
  
  test_pred <- predict_regsubsets(forward_select, test, forward_sizes[i])
  test_mse_forward[i] <- mean((test$Salary - test_pred)^2)
}

forward_results <- data.frame(
  Criterion = criteria,
  nVars = forward_sizes,
  Train_MSE = train_mse_forward,
  Test_MSE = test_mse_forward
)

print(forward_results)
```

6. Backward Stepwise Selection
```{r}
# Backward stepwise selection
backward_select <- regsubsets(Salary ~ ., data = train, nvmax = 19, 
                              method = "backward")
backward_summary <- summary(backward_select)

# Find best models
backward_adjr2 <- which.max(backward_summary$adjr2)
backward_bic <- which.min(backward_summary$bic)
backward_cp <- which.min(backward_summary$cp)

# Calculate MSE for backward stepwise
train_mse_backward <- numeric(3)
test_mse_backward <- numeric(3)
backward_sizes <- c(backward_adjr2, backward_bic, backward_cp)

for(i in 1:3) {
  train_pred <- predict_regsubsets(backward_select, train, backward_sizes[i])
  train_mse_backward[i] <- mean((train$Salary - train_pred)^2)
  
  test_pred <- predict_regsubsets(backward_select, test, backward_sizes[i])
  test_mse_backward[i] <- mean((test$Salary - test_pred)^2)
}

backward_results <- data.frame(
  Criterion = criteria,
  nVars = backward_sizes,
  Train_MSE = train_mse_backward,
  Test_MSE = test_mse_backward
)

print(backward_results)
```

7. Comparison of All Methods
```{r}
# Create comparison table
comparison <- data.frame(
  Method = rep(c("Best Subset", "Forward", "Backward"), each = 3),
  Criterion = rep(criteria, 3),
  nVars = c(best_sizes, forward_sizes, backward_sizes),
  Train_MSE = c(train_mse_best, train_mse_forward, train_mse_backward),
  Test_MSE = c(test_mse_best, test_mse_forward, test_mse_backward)
)

print(comparison)

# Summary statistics
cat("\nSummary of Test MSE across methods:\n")
print(tapply(comparison$Test_MSE, comparison$Method, summary))
```
